protocol.baseline_comparison: Frozen v1.4 historical out-of-fold control, temporal and gate models; no all-seven comparator on scored folds.
protocol.exposure: All seven Sportec matches exposed; development CV only. Neither fresh source enters training or selection.
protocol.fresh_audit_policy: Freeze one eligible candidate, or the highest-ranked experiment if none eligible, before fresh reference access. Both development and fresh gates are required for promotion. MetricaGame3 sparse provider-event accuracy and balancedrecall nondecreasing; annotation method unverified. Two reserved SkillCorner automatic-phase matches mean accuracy nondecreasing, maximumindividualdrop .02. Gaps unknown; no fresh human denseHAD claim. Failure retainsv1.4; no runner-up or retuning.

joint_training.weights: H/A inverse-sqrt spell weights; D=1; +/-0.4s known-state transitions have minimum1.5; X=0

release_decision.reason: Promoted joint-state after passing both the fixed development gates and the one-shot three-match fresh audit.
